# AURO — AI-First Lead Nurturing & Qualification for Dubai Real Estate
> AURO is the AI-first lead nurturing and qualification multi-agent system for Dubai's leading real estate agencies and developers. Automates lead qualification, personalized outreach, and meeting booking via WhatsApp, email, and SMS.
